actual_full_visual_review.ground_contact_error_not_proven: Actual consumed source tail is a close-up with feet outside the frame. Do not infer erroneous contact from standing off the original mat.

background_metrics.scope: Fixed distant background only; does not measure all near-body occlusion, contact, action, or overall quality. RGB steps are diagnostics, not percent quality improvements.
